# Medieval cutouts

A legacy collection of 41 painted cut-outs in a medieval manuscript style (animal and human musicians, drolleries, readers and single animals) whose origin was never recorded.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `medieval-cutouts`, imported, 41 assets.

## Licence and attribution

Artwork: **CC-BY-4.0** ([text](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode)). Origin unrecorded; attribution to adrian729. Removed on any rights claim.

Author: adrian729. Maintainer: https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets/issues. See [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md).

## Use one asset

No version is published yet. Once it is, pin the exact version (never `@latest`); the URL scheme is:

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@ranx729/ducktape-assets-medieval-cutouts@<version>/webp/<asset-id>-<width>.webp
```

Package `@ranx729/ducktape-assets-medieval-cutouts`; every file, width and format is listed in its `manifest.json`. Masters live in git under `assets/<id>/` and in `@ranx729/ducktape-assets-medieval-cutouts-masters`; never put a master on a page.
